name: GB300 NVL72
notes: Source datasheet publishes 'Total FP8/FP6 Tensor Core: 720 PFLOPS' as one combined figure (720,000 TFLOPS here), and per footnote 2 this is a sparse spec (dense is half) -- both total_fp8_tensor_sparse_tflops and total_fp6_tensor_sparse_tflops carry that value, no independent dense variant given at rack-total level. Cross-checks against per-GPU b300-sxm-gb300nvl72.json record: 8000 GB/s/GPU x 72 = 576,000 GB/s (matches total_gpu_memory_bandwidth_gbps); 279GB/GPU x 72 = 20,088GB (~matches vendor-rounded 20 TB); 2,592 CPU cores / 36 Grace CPUs = 72 cores/CPU (consistent with Neoverse V2 72-core config). Networking per_gpu_bandwidth_gbps of 100 GB/s derived from source's '800 Gbps ConnectX-8 per GPU' (800 Gb/s = 100 GB/s), not independently vendor-published in GB/s. power_kw_max not stated in this datasheet; other NVIDIA/Supermicro/partner docs (Supermicro GB200/GB300 NVL72 datasheets) independently cite 120-140kW per rack -- left null here rather than treating an analog-system estimate as this record's sourced value; needs a GB300-specific power source before populating.
